brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer at a corner of a cell, touching the cell
requirements.evidence: No drawer placed. With pieces at 0,0,0; 0,1,0; 1,0,0 the configurator offers no drawer socket at the shared junction (0,0|0,1|1,0). A drawer needs a notch frame in an empty cell between two touching bases; the only drawer-frame notch offered for this L-shape was at 1,1 k=2, which is a different junction, not the same corner as the spike.

requirements.requirement: One spike at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: No spike placed on final build. Earlier a spike at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 (spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0) was placeable when 4 bases formed a triangle, but it cannot coexist with a drawer at that same junction - the configurator offers no drawer socket there, so both touching simultaneously is not placeable.

requirements.requirement: Both at the very same corner, touching each other / the same cell
requirements.evidence: Configurator enforces mutual exclusion at a junction. Tested: placing spike at 0,0|0,1|1,0 then checking drawer offers yields 0 sockets; placing notch drawer frame at 1,1 k=2 then trying spike at same junction is a different junction. No socket pair exists for both at identical corner. Current build has 3 bases and no drawer or spike.

finish.summary: Build has 3 full bases in L-shape (0,0,0; 0,1,0; 1,0,0) with no drawer or spike. A spike is offerable alone at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 and a drawer frame alone would require a 4th base, but the configurator offers no drawer socket at that same junction, so both touching at the identical corner is not placeable as asked. Check_build shows clear mesh but LOOSE_BODY warning.
